intro: To delete one chat in ChatGPT on Mac, open the Chat History sidebar, Control-click the chat, choose Delete, then click Delete in the warning. Deleted chats leave your account view right away and are permanently removed from OpenAI systems within 30 days, with a few exceptions explained below.
tldr: Open the Chat History sidebar, Control-click the chat, choose Delete, then click Delete in the warning.
Deleted chats leave your account view right away. OpenAI says they are permanently removed within 30 days, with exceptions.
Delete All Chats lives in Settings, and guides disagree on the path. Check your own screen before you click.
To hide a chat instead, lock it in the new desktop app under Projects > Locked chats. A forgotten PIN reset deletes locked chats.

blocks.text: Before you start: the Mac app or the website?

The steps in the list above are for the ChatGPT app on your Mac. The website in a browser has its own three-dot menu and its own quirks. Check which one you have open before you follow any step. The Mac app needs macOS 14 or later and an Apple Silicon Mac, which means an M1 chip or newer.

The single-chat steps are the part this page could verify least. They come from one third-party guide, iGeeksBlog, which paraphrases OpenAI's help article. This page could not check OpenAI's own help pages, because they blocked access. Your build may place things differently. When your screen disagrees with a step, trust your screen.
What happens to a chat after you delete it

Deleting takes the chat out of your account view right away. That part is quick. The data itself follows a longer path. OpenAI says deleted chats are permanently removed from its systems within 30 days.

There are exceptions. Data that was already de-identified and disassociated from your account can stay. So can data kept for security or legal reasons. Most people never think about this. It helps to know the rule before you delete something sensitive.

Deleting in the app is not the same as wiping every trace. Sync can lag between devices, and the bug reports later on this page show how that looks in practice. Plan for the chat to linger on other screens for a while.
Delete all chats in ChatGPT on Mac
Deleting every chat is a different job, and it lives in Settings. Guides disagree on the exact path. Try the first path below. If it does not match your screen, try the second.

items: Click ChatGPT in the menu bar, then choose Settings.
Click Delete All Chats, then click Confirm.

blocks.text: The second path comes from iDownloadBlog's July 2025 article. It starts by clicking your name in the lower-left corner, then Settings, then Data Controls, then Delete All Chats, then Confirm. That article covers only deleting all chats on macOS. It does not say which app version it tested.

Clearing history removes chats from the app only. OpenAI may still store the conversations, and ChatGPT may still refer to them. iDownloadBlog makes that point directly. It matters most when your reason for clearing is privacy.

blocks.title: Read the confirmation
blocks.text: Delete All removes every chat in your list, not just one. Read the confirmation text before you click Confirm. If you only need one chat gone, use the single-chat steps above.
Hide a chat with Locked Chats instead

If you want a chat hidden rather than removed, check Locked Chats. OpenAI launched it on Oct 20, 2026, in the new ChatGPT desktop app for macOS and Windows, according to Fortune. Locked chats leave regular history, pinned chats, and search.
Find them under Projects > Locked chats. A PIN opens them. Hidden chats are easy to lose track of, so note what you locked and where you put it.

The rollout is gradual across Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu plans. ChatGPT for Healthcare is not on that list. Voice does not work in locked chats on desktop. If you do not see the feature, your account may not have it yet.

blocks.title: Forgotten PIN
blocks.text: Resetting a forgotten PIN permanently deletes all locked chats, memories stored only in those chats, and files protected only by the old PIN. OpenAI says this cannot be undone. Changing a PIN you still remember deletes nothing.

The difference matters. Deleting removes a chat from your account view and starts the 30-day removal. Locking only hides it. A forgotten PIN reset also removes locked chats, which is why the PIN matters so much.

blocks.text: Using the website in a browser

A March 2025 OpenAI community thread reports that the three-dot menu did not remove a chat from history for some web users. The workaround that worked there was to archive the chat, then delete it from the archive in Settings. Refreshing and logging out did not help.
That thread is about the web, not the Mac app. Still, the pattern shows up on both. A delete in one place does not guarantee the chat leaves every list at once. Check both places when it matters.
Keyboard shortcuts for chats

Two shortcuts from the same guide are worth knowing. Command, Shift and N together start a Temporary Chat, which is not saved to history. Option and Space open the Chat Bar, so you can ask a quick question without opening the full app window.

The shortcut for a new regular chat conflicts across sources, so this page does not list one. Use a Temporary Chat when you want an answer and no saved history. For more on the Chat Bar, read [How to use the Option+Space shortcut in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/use-the-option-space-shortcut-in-chatgpt).
Where Lazur fits in

Lazur is a voice assistant for the Mac that lives in the notch. Hold Option and Command together, ask about what is on screen, and Lazur answers out loud. It looks at your screen only while you hold the shortcut.
Ask where something is, and Lazur draws a circle and a label around it. Ask how to do something, and Lazur guides you one click at a time, waiting for each click. It does not click for you.
For this task, ask Lazur to point at Chat History, then to walk you through the Control-click and the warning. You stay in control of every click. Lazur only tells you where to go.
Common mistakes people make

items: Following the website steps in the Mac app, or the reverse. The menus are not the same.
Assuming deleted means gone that second. The 30-day window still applies.
Locking a chat when you wanted it removed. Locked chats still sit under Projects > Locked chats.
Forgetting the PIN for locked chats. A reset deletes them for good.
Clearing history and assuming nothing is stored. iDownloadBlog says OpenAI may still store conversations.
Trusting one guide's menu path without checking your own screen first.

blocks.text: A safe way to test the delete

Before you remove a chat you care about, test on a throwaway one. Start a new chat, type one short message, and wait for it to appear in Chat History. Then run the single-chat steps on that test chat.

blocks.title: Test first
blocks.text: Make a throwaway chat with one short message. Delete it with the steps above, then check the sidebar before you touch real work.
If the test chat leaves the list and stays out, the steps work on your build. If it stays in the list, skip to the troubleshooting section and check the bug notes before you try again.
Known bugs with stale chats in Recents

The clearest bug report is from September 2026. A Mac user said chats deleted on a phone or another computer stayed in Recents. The thread lists build 26.908.40834, reported Sept 14, 2026. Some entries showed Cannot load this conversation, and deleting them failed with Failed to delete conversation.

OpenAI staff said on Sept 18, 2026 that a fix was deployed. On Sept 26, they confirmed the problem still happened for some users. That status may have changed since then, so check the thread before you spend a long time on it.
The workarounds in the troubleshooting list are user-reported. OpenAI has not confirmed them. They are still worth trying, because they cost you very little.
Where to go next

If you attach files to chats, the paperclip steps are on [How to attach a file in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/attach-a-file-in-chatgpt). That page covers the next thing most people try after a chat cleanup.
To compare the ChatGPT app with Lazur, read [ChatGPT on Mac vs Lazur](/apps/chatgpt). If you want to try Lazur on your own screen, the [download page](/download) has the Mac app.

faq.question: Can I get a deleted ChatGPT chat back on Mac?
faq.answer: The sources on this page do not describe a way to undo a deleted chat. Treat a delete as final. Copy anything you need from the chat before you confirm the warning.

faq.question: Does deleting a chat remove it from OpenAI right away?
faq.answer: Not always. Deleted chats leave your account view right away. OpenAI says deleted chats are permanently removed from its systems within 30 days, unless an exception applies.

faq.question: Is there a keyboard shortcut to delete one chat on Mac?
faq.answer: Not one this page could verify. The single-chat steps use Control-click and a menu. A web community thread mentioned Ctrl+Shift+Backspace, but that is for the web version, and OpenAI did not confirm it.

faq.question: Does deleting on my Mac also delete the chat on my iPhone?
faq.answer: This page does not confirm how deletes sync across devices. A Mac user reported chats deleted on a phone or another computer still showed in Recents. Check your other devices after you delete.

faq.question: Can Shortcuts on Mac delete ChatGPT chats automatically?
faq.answer: Not as of February 2025. An Apple Developer Forums thread says Apple DTS confirmed the ChatGPT app has no way for Shortcuts to delete chats. Check for newer support before you build a workflow around it.

faq.question: What is the difference between deleting and locking a chat?
faq.answer: Deleting removes the chat from your account view and starts the 30-day removal. Locking hides the chat behind a PIN under Projects > Locked chats, in the new desktop app. Locked chats also leave search.

faq.question: Does the ChatGPT Mac app run on any Mac?
faq.answer: No. iGeeksBlog says the Mac app needs macOS 14 or later and an Apple Silicon Mac, M1 or newer. An Intel Mac falls outside the steps on this page.

faq.question: Why does a deleted chat still appear in Recents?
faq.answer: A reported bug in a macOS build from September 2026 can leave stale entries. The troubleshooting list has the workarounds people tried. OpenAI asked affected users to contact Support with their app and macOS versions.

steps.name: Open the Chat History sidebar
steps.text: Open the ChatGPT app on your Mac and open the Chat History sidebar. This is the list of your saved conversations. The chat you want to remove has to be in this list before you can delete it.
steps.tip: The single-chat steps do not say where the sidebar toggle sits. If you cannot see the list, look for the sidebar control in the app window.

steps.name: Control-click the chat
steps.text: Find the chat by its title. Hold Control and click the title. A small menu opens with more options for that chat.
steps.tip: Read the title twice before you go on. Similar titles are easy to mix up.

steps.name: Choose Delete
steps.text: In the menu that opens, choose Delete. Nothing is removed yet. The app asks you to confirm first.

steps.name: Confirm in the warning
steps.text: A warning appears. Read it, then click Delete again to confirm. According to the iGeeksBlog guide, the chat leaves your account view right away.

steps.name: Check the sidebar
steps.text: Look at Chat History again. The chat should be gone. If it still shows, do not delete it a second time. Read the troubleshooting list first, because stale entries are a known problem.
steps.tip: If you see 'Failed to delete conversation', the troubleshooting list covers that message.

steps.name: Know the 30-day window
steps.text: Deleting takes the chat out of your view right away. OpenAI says it permanently removes deleted chats from its systems within 30 days. Data already de-identified and disassociated from your account, or kept for security or legal reasons, is an exception.
steps.tip: Copy anything you need from the chat before you confirm the delete.

troubleshooting.problem: Deleted chat still shows in Recents on Mac
troubleshooting.fix: This is a reported bug, not something you did wrong. Open the stuck chat in Quick Chat, send a message, then delete it. That worked for some users. Signing out, quitting, and clearing the com.openai.chat cache did not fix it for the original poster.

troubleshooting.problem: Chat says Cannot load this conversation
troubleshooting.fix: Some stale chats show this message, and deleting them can fail with Failed to delete conversation. Try the Quick Chat workaround first. If the chat stays, contact OpenAI Support with your app and macOS versions, and say whether the chat shows on the web.

troubleshooting.problem: Delete option missing from the menu
troubleshooting.fix: The single-chat steps come from one third-party guide, and builds can differ. Check that you have the latest app, then look again. If Delete is still missing, delete the chat from the website and check the Mac app afterward.

troubleshooting.problem: Chat vanished from history and search
troubleshooting.fix: It may be a locked chat. Locked chats are hidden from history, pinned chats, and search. Open Projects > Locked chats and enter your PIN. Locked Chats is in the new desktop app, so you need that version.

troubleshooting.problem: Chat still appears on the website after Delete
troubleshooting.fix: A March 2025 community thread reports this for some web users. Archive the chat first, then delete it from the archive in Settings. Refreshing and logging out did not help in that thread.

troubleshooting.problem: Forgot the PIN for locked chats
troubleshooting.fix: A reset permanently deletes all locked chats, memories stored only in those chats, and files protected only by the old PIN. OpenAI says this cannot be undone. If you still remember the PIN, change it instead, which deletes nothing.
